newsitem.title: USA: Ameriserve Food Distribution sells 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Ameriserve Food Distribution sells 144A notes.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Ameriserve Food Distributiion Inc was priced Wednesday via lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, according to a market source.
Ameriserve is a unit of Nebco Evans Holding Co. Ameriserve, based in Brookfield, Wis., is one of the largest foodservice systems distributors in the United States.
Ameriserve will use proceeds from the offering to purchase PFS, the foodservice distribution operation of Pepsico Inc.
